verdict.rationale: Jan is a local-first AI app, and a product of this type could plausibly offer its own hosted inference tier, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows connections to third-party providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq and others). It documents no Jan-hosted cloud tier and no pricing tiers, rate limits or usage caps. Third-party cloud integration is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.
